errors.text_span: in the “Cardio” group, the Neuro-fine-tuned model (brown) performs worse than the baseline.
errors.evidence: This statement is factually incorrect. In the "Cardio" group, the baseline model (light blue bar) has a negative log probability of -22. The Neuro-fine-tuned model (light brown bar) has a value of approximately -25.8. Since lower values are better, the Neuro-fine-tuned model performs significantly better, not worse, than the baseline on Cardio terms.

errors.text_span: while potentially degrading performance on others
errors.evidence: This is an incorrect interpretation of the chart's overall trend. In every group of bars, the baseline model (light blue) has the highest (least negative) value, meaning all fine-tuned models show improved performance over the baseline across all specialty term categories, not degraded performance. This statement misrepresents the central finding of the figure.

errors.text_span: with lower values indicating higher model confidence (i.e., better prediction)
errors.evidence: While this is a correct interpretation in the context of machine learning, it goes beyond a direct description of the visual elements of the chart. The chart itself does not explicitly state that lower values mean 'better prediction' or 'higher confidence'.
